## Hi there!
I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at the [University of Nottingham Ningbo China](https://www.nottingham.edu.cn/) and a member of [Centre for Decision Research and Experimental Economics (CeDEx) China](https://www.nottingham.edu.cn/en/humanities-and-social-sciences/schools-and-department/economics/research/research-centres/cedex-china/home.aspx). My research focuses on experimental and behavioural economics and decision theory, with a particular interest in how self-perception influences economic decision-making in labour market and search environments. My research primarily employs experimental methods to test theoretical predictions and study individual behaviour, while I also conduct empirical research on related topics.

:::
